title: Compare explicit expected harms
hook: Two stated cases: explore the stipulated risks in a decision tree.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the stipulated risks in a decision tree affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Difference, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the stipulated risks in a decision tree in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
